tasks.short: Deliver arrangements or oversee the employees who deliver them.

steps.what: List customers, arrangements and delivery windows
Sort those deliveries by window and area
Check that delivery order against the flowers
Tell employees which deliveries they take
Deliver the arrangements to those customers

tasks.design: The floral designer lists customer, arrangement, window and area in {DOCS}. A configured sort orders that list; she checks it against the flowers, tells employees the run, and still delivers the arrangements. The sort sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The run depends on traffic, stem condition and who is in that morning, so a fixed route was not worth building.
tasks.enabler_now: She already writes customer, window and area. Sorting those fields is configuration. The drive stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to see the flowers and the street. A sorted list does not deliver them.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell whether an arrangement will survive the trip and whether an employee can take that run.

ambition.what: Before she leaves she sees which delivery windows clash and settles that clash in the same sitting.

tasks.altitude: She still assigns the run and still delivers. She spends less time reordering the list by hand.

reach.task: Place the arrangement on the set only after this run is accepted.
reach.learn: Which deliveries were held back because the flowers would not travel.

evidence.claim: A florist writes the day's drops from orders and sorts them by time and area before anyone leaves. Sorting fields she has already entered is configuration. Model knowledge.

assumptions: She produces the delivery list herself: customer, arrangement, address, window and area. A missing field is filled by her before the sort. Nothing is read from a photo.
The delivery share is her time on the run or beside the employee, not the employee's driving time.
She tells employees the run in person. The design stores no location trail.
Upkeep is 2 hours per 100 baseline hours for area names she keeps current. The check in s3 is already in her remaining time and is not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether she delivers herself or only oversees employees, and whether every recipient is outside the company.
research_questions: How often is an address or a window missing when she starts the list?

already_counted.description: She checks the sorted run against the flowers before anyone leaves.

incremental.description: She keeps area names current so the sort still matches the streets she uses.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The sort is the only step that shortens, about 8 per 100, minus 2 to keep area names. If she must chase missing addresses first, only the low end returns. The list, the check, the talk with employees and the delivery stay.

tasks.short: Select flora and foliage and try combinations for new arrangements.

steps.what: Look through the flora and foliage on hand
Try combinations of that flora and foliage
Select the flora and foliage for the arrangement

tasks.design: She selects flora and foliage from the stems in front of her and tries combinations until the arrangement holds. No tool drafts that choice and nothing is filed from it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The choice depends on what is in the cooler today and on the look she wants. A standing list does not see the stems.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the handling of live stems. The selection stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: Colour, condition and the brief change together. Only she can hold them at once.
tasks.human_edge: She judges colour, condition and the brief while she holds the stems.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still looks, tries and selects.

reach.task: Build a companion piece only from stems she has already selected.
reach.learn: Which combinations she tried and put back.

evidence.claim: Choosing live stems is done at the bench from what is on hand. A picture of a combination is not that selection. Model knowledge. The digest keeps final selection manual.

assumptions: No step is shortened, so incremental hours are 0. There is no mapping or note file to maintain on this task.
The arrangement she tries is the work itself, not a record that a later step files.
unknowns: Whether a client brief names the palette so tightly that the selection is not hers.
research_questions: How often does she put a combination back because the stems in the cooler differ from the brief?

already_counted.description: She selects the stems herself after trying combinations.

incremental.description: No upkeep. No note file or mapping is added on this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still looks, tries and selects. No step has a mechanism that shortens it, and there is no upkeep to deduct.

tasks.short: Order flowers and supplies from wholesalers and growers.

steps.what: Count flowers and supplies the week still needs
Choose the grower and quantity for each line
Draft the purchase order from those flower lines
Check the purchase order against flowers and grower
Send the accepted purchase order to that wholesaler
Call the grower when a flower line is short

tasks.design: She counts what the week still needs and writes item, quantity and grower in {DOCS}. A configured draft in {EMAIL} turns those lines into the purchase order; she checks it, and {EMAIL} sends only that accepted text to the wholesaler. A short line is a call, not a second send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantity and grower change with what the cooler is short of, so a standing order was often wrong.
tasks.enabler_now: She can enter item, quantity and grower, and the mailbox can send only the text she has accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A grower may not have the stem. That call stays with her.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which grower is straight about a short stem and what the week can actually use.

ambition.what: On a short line she names a second grower before the order is sent, in that same order, rather than after the first grower refuses.

tasks.altitude: She still chooses every line and still agrees the text that leaves. She retypes the order less often.

reach.task: Do not plan a stem this order did not cover.
reach.learn: Which lines she left blank because no grower could fill them.

evidence.claim: Flower orders to growers go out from the shop by mail or by phone after someone has counted the cooler. Model knowledge. The digest names no product that places these orders.

assumptions: She produces each line: item, quantity, grower and delivery day. The draft uses only those lines. A missing price stays blank for her to fill and is not guessed.
Wholesalers and growers are outside the company, so the mail is an external send. The call when a line is short is talk, not a second send.
A change to quantity, grower or day voids the send acceptance.
Upkeep is 4 hours per 100 baseline hours: she keeps item names and grower mail addresses current. That maintenance is her work. The check in s4 is already counted.
unknowns: Whether the company already has a purchasing record the grower reads, which would make this mail a duplicate send.
research_questions: How often does she change a line after the grower replies that the stem is short?

already_counted.description: She checks the purchase order against the lines and the grower before it is sent.

incremental.description: She keeps item names and grower mail addresses current.

approvals.approved_version: Purchase order as the floral designer accepted it for this grower and delivery day

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The draft and the send return about 16 per 100, minus 4 to keep item names and grower addresses. If she rewrites most orders after the grower replies, only the low end remains. The count, the choice, the check and the call stay.

tasks.short: Tell customers how to care for flowers, foliage and plants.

steps.what: Ask which plants and foliage the customer has
Draft handling lines for those plants and foliage

loop.input: The plant names and the place she wrote for this customer, plus the handling notes she already keeps.
loop.output: One handling line per plant she named, limited to water, light or cut.
loop.check: The line names a plant she entered and a handling point already in her notes. Reject a plant she did not name and any warning that is not in those notes.
loop.stop: Every named plant has one accepted line or is marked unknown for her to say herself. One pass per plant. She rewrites a rejected line.
loop.why_not_simpler: The customer names a mix of plants and a place in her own words. A fixed line per product code misses that mix.

steps.what: Check each handling line against these plants
Inform the customer how to handle these plants

tasks.design: She notes the plant and the place. A bounded draft in {DOCS} proposes one handling line from notes she maintains; she rejects a line that names another plant or a warning not in those notes, then tells the customer herself. Nothing is mailed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care depends on the plant in front of her and the place the customer describes. A fixed label misses that pair.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose a line from notes she already keeps, and she still says it.
tasks.still_hard: A wilted stem or a worried customer is not in the notes. She still judges that in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the customer understood and changes what she says.

ambition.what: Before she speaks she has one handling point per plant in front of her, and she drops any line that is not in her notes.

tasks.altitude: She still tells every customer the care herself. She spends less time hunting a line she has said before.

reach.task: Do not repeat a handling line she has not accepted.
reach.learn: Which plants she marked unknown and said herself.

evidence.claim: Care is said at the bench from the plant in hand. A draft can only propose a line the designer already keeps and still checks. Model knowledge.

assumptions: She produces plant name and place before any line is drafted. A plant she did not name is marked unknown.
The draft may only repeat a handling point already in her notes. It does not add a warning about eating a plant or about a pet.
She speaks the care. No separate message is sent, so there is no release gate.
Upkeep is 3 hours per 100 baseline hours: she keeps those handling notes current. That is her work. The check in s3 is already counted.
unknowns: Whether a plant's care for this household is unsafe to shorten, and whether the customer already left with a grower's own note.
research_questions: How often is the plant she is asked about missing from her handling notes?

already_counted.description: She checks each handling line against the plant before she speaks.

incremental.description: She keeps the handling notes current so a draft can only repeat them.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The draft returns about 12 per 100, minus 3 to keep handling notes. If most plants are marked unknown, only the low end remains. Asking and telling the customer stay in full.

role.altitude: She still picks every stem, still delivers or rides the run, still agrees every purchase order, and still tells the customer the care herself. Less of the week goes to reordering the run and retyping the order. She does not gain a right to skip a delivery or to treat a draft line as told.
reach: Set and Exhibit Designers place an arrangement only after she has accepted the run, and they learn which deliveries she held back.
Craft Artists do not repeat a handling line she has not accepted, and they learn which plants she marked unknown.
skills_to_grow: Enter customer, arrangement, window and area before a run is sorted.
Enter item, quantity and grower before a purchase order is filled.
Name the plant and the place before a handling line is drafted.
role.ambitious_version: On a short-cooler morning she sees the clashing delivery windows before she leaves, and she has already named a second grower on a short line. She still selects the stems herself and still says the care aloud. She does not publish a design, and she does not treat a draft line as told.
